lines.text: Old and unable to see, Isaac tells Esau to hunt game and cook a tasty dish so Isaac can bless him.
Rebekah dresses Jacob in Esau's finest clothes, puts goatskins on his hands and neck, and hands him tasty food and wine.
Jacob tells Isaac he is Esau and says an angel of the LORD brought him the game, and Isaac touches his hairy hands.

wrong_details.wrong: an angel of the LORD brought him the game
wrong_details.true: the LORD your God brought it to him
